name: My Fake Fiance
source:
When your friends Killian, Alex, and Dylan ask you to become their fake fiancée, will you accept and date all of them?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
基利安、亞歷克斯和迪倫這三個朋友都來請你假扮自己的未婚妻。你會答應，同時和他們三個交往嗎？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
